records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended June 30, 2025 were $235,920,000, a decrease of $3,806,000 or 1.6% from the three months ended June 30, 2024 net sales of $239,726,000.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To date, we have raised prices to our customers to cover these increased raw material costs and are working with our supply base to prioritize shipments and improve availability of key components.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were positively impacted by $2,443,000 due to price increases, offset by $9,375,000 of unfavorable sales volume.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our principal raw materials and components purchases were approximately $375 million in fiscal 2025 (or 59% of Cost of product sold) and include steel, consisting of rod, wire, bar, structural, and other forms of steel; electric motors; bearings; gear reducers; castings; steel and aluminum enclosures and wire harnesses; electro-mechanical components; and standard variable drives and controls.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used for operating activities was $18,153,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2025 compared to $10,758,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2024.
